headline: n8n or Make, same sheet.
subline: Pick the tool you already use. Both score every lead against ICP.md.

cards.label: n8n
cards.title: n8n asks Evaboot
cards.quote: Every Monday, n8n asks Evaboot to export the search. A lead already in the sheet is <u>updated</u>.

cards.label: Make
cards.title: Evaboot pushes to Make
cards.quote: A weekly recurring export pushes each batch to Make. Every lead is <u>added as a new row</u>.
